purpose: Teach: ミッキー/ウィリアムズ/クック/ヘレン/ダビデ/ケイト/トミー/メリー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがディズニーランドにミッキーに会いに連れて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to take you to Disneyland to meet Mickey.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Gentle smile in the voice. Sharing something nice she knows will delight him. Steady pace, no rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとテニスのウィリアムズ姉妹の試合観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched the Williams sisters tennis match with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, eager energy. Quick attack on the opening word. Small boy's pride in having done something cool. Natural, unforced excitement — not performing, just sharing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが探検家ジェームズ・クックの絵本を読んで下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to read you a picture book about explorer James Cook.
lines.style: Gentle, attentive tone. Slightly dreamy quality — she's imaging how nice this will be for him. Soft pacing, like she's offering something precious.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとヘレン・ケラーの伝記絵本読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I read a picture book about Helen Keller with Dad.
lines.style: Warm, genuinely pleased. Simple directness — no embellishment needed. Small laugh underneath, like he's proud of what he learned and eager to share it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ダビデ像はミケランジェロの傑作」って教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is teaching you that Michelangelo's David is a masterpiece.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reverential tone. She's relaying something important without overstating it. Slight pause before the word 'masterpiece' — letting the idea breathe.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと英王室のケイト妃の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I looked at a picture book about Kate, the princess in the British royal family, with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, matter-of-fact. Quick pace, natural rhythm. Small boy reporting back what he's learned, comfortable and unselfconscious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「機関車トーマスのトミーって名前のキャラ」を教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad taught you that the character in Thomas the Tank Engine is named Tommy.
lines.style: Soft, slightly amused. She finds this detail charming — the specificity of a dad explaining something small that matters to a six-year-old. Warm cadence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとメリー・ポピンズの映画観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched Mary Poppins with Dad.
lines.style: Contented, closing warmth. Slower than before, like he's savoring the memory. Soft on the ending — no need to punch it. Small and genuine.
